description: DST gap and overlap check for local times and stated offsets in an IANA zone — Checks up to 100 local date-times (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM) or offset timestamps against an IANA time zone and reports whether each wall time exists once, never (spring-forward gap) or twice (fall-back overlap), with every real instant and the offset in force; also lists a zone's offset transitions in a year. Built for an agent scheduling a meeting, cron job or deadline in someone else's zone. Uses the r

local.description: Wall time without offset. Exactly one of local or timestamp.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with offset; checked for consistency with the zone's offset at that instant; Z names UTC and makes no local claim, so it is never a mismatch.

name: dst-check
